about_the_game:
DODGEBRAWL is a multiplayer PvP dodgeball-themed FPS, full of maps, game modes, equipment, and chaos.

Experience the nostalgic fun of everyone's favorite gym class activity, with some added wackiness and fun elements that wouldn't work in a real basketball court! Ever wanted to use a beach ball as a dodgeball? What about a boomerang, or a baseball, or... a land mine?

DODGEBRAWL is more than just a digital version of the classic sport, it's an experience with the community. Play a pickup game with a few of your friends, or join a public game with a bunch of players! 

FEATURES

  • Online multiplayer with up to 32 players

  • LAN multiplayer with unlimited player count

  • 3 game modes and 6 maps

  • 10+ unique throwables

  • Proximity voice chat

  • Character customization*

  • Steam networking for hosting servers, no port forwarding required*

*Requires DODGEBRAWL Full Version Upgrade in release version.

DODGEBRAWL Playtest

For a limited time, anyone can sign up for the DODGEBRAWL Playtest to help test and develop the game in its early phases. This version contains all benefits of the Full Version of DODGEBRAWL until the end of the playtest phase.

GUEST PASS

Once the game releases, the DODGEBRAWL Guest Pass will allow users to play the game as many times as they want, for free, forever. However, for the frequent gym attendee, we will recommend an upgrade to the Full Version in order to unlock greater character customization and self-hosting of lobbies.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560 or equivalent
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 or equivalent
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: An FPS reimagining of the best gym class sport, DODGEBRAWL is a transformation of iconic shooter game modes into the context of an athletic activity. Play for free today!
